description: Taboola server-to-server conversion postbacks on trc.taboola.com/actions-handler/log/3/s2s-action. The base pixel loader is vendor/taboola. Bulk submit is vendor/taboola-s2s-bulk. Browser collect on the same host is not contracted.

params.name: click-id
params.description: It is the Taboola Click ID from the landing page. Taboola documents the query key as `click-id`, exactly, and says another spelling records no conversion.
params.fix_hint: Send `click-id` with the Click ID Taboola appended to the landing page.

params.name: name
params.description: It is the event name as defined in Realize Conversion settings, not the Conversion Name.
params.fix_hint: Set `name` to the Event Name from Realize, such as `LEAD` or `PURCHASE`.

params.name: revenue
params.description: It is the conversion value. Taboola documents an integer or decimal number, such as `10` or `9.99`.

params.name: currency
params.description: It is the revenue currency. Taboola documents a fixed list of three-letter codes, case-sensitive. Omit it to use the account default.
params.fix_hint: Use a documented code such as `USD`.

params.name: quantity
params.description: It is the item quantity in the order. Taboola documents an integer.
params.fix_hint: Send an integer quantity, such as `3`.

params.name: orderid
params.description: It is an order ID from the advertiser CRM. Taboola documents it as optional.
